test_item:
ECUCert CSR export interface
(CSR is read over DID $2965 and exported to a file)
pre:
1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
2. Diagnostic session is SystemSupplierSpecific (60)
3. ADA Active Roles permit ADA+ protected data identifiers
input: DUT whose ECU serial number has been written; CSR is generated automatically at boot
proc:
1. Send UDS request DiagnosticSessionControl for SystemSupplierSpecific session
$ 10 60
2. Send UDS request ReadDataByIdentifier for DID $2965 (CSR Read)
$ 22 29 65
3. Confirm the exported CSR file is present on the DUT
$ adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity
er:
1. Positive response is received: 50 60
2. Positive response is received: 62 29 65 <CSR bytes>, up to 1000 bytes (CS.00102 5.2.2.75, SYS-RA-CS00102-415)
3. `$ adb shell ls -l /data/misc/ecuidentity` lists the exported CSR file
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: R-SEC6(a) UDS step form; CS.00102 5.2.2.75 (SYS-RA-CS00102-415~418); ECU Cert Test Steps PDF Step 2
SWE ID pending; SYSAD used per R-SEC8(a). DID value per CS.00102; R1L Diag SWQT 22403/22404 returns up to 2048 bytes (A-SEC-3)
